questions.subject: WEB_DEVELOPMENT
questions.topic: Reading a tab order and then counting the presses needed
questions.stem: A city planner's memo sets tabindex='2' on one element among natural-order peers; what happens to tab order?

options.text: Positive tabindex elements are visited first in numeric order
options.misconception: thinks tabindex 2 inserts after natural peers

questions.explanation: Positive tabindex values are visited before tabindex 0 and -1 elements, in numeric order. Avoid positive values.

questions.subject: WEB_DEVELOPMENT
questions.topic: Why a visible error message beside a field is not enough
questions.stem: A city planner's memo links an error message to a field; which attribute creates that link?

options.text: aria-labelledby pointing to the error id
aria-describedby pointing to the error id

questions.explanation: aria-describedby associates supplementary text such as an error message with the field. aria-labelledby names the field.

questions.subject: WEB_DEVELOPMENT
questions.topic: The order a dialog's focus management has to happen in
questions.stem: A city planner's memo closes a dialog but leaves focus on the body; what is the problem?

options.text: Keyboard users lose their place and must navigate back

questions.explanation: On close, focus must return to the trigger so users keep their place. Leaving it on body disorients keyboard users.

questions.subject: WEB_DEVELOPMENT
questions.topic: Resolving described references against the ids that exist
questions.stem: A city planner's memo sets aria-describedby to two ids; explain how the descriptions are announced.

answer.exemplar: Both referenced elements' text are announced as the description, in order, separated by spaces. Missing ids are skipped without error.

questions.explanation: Multiple ids in aria-describedby are resolved in order and their text concatenated. Missing ones are ignored.
questions.hint: All existing targets join in order.

questions.topic: Which autofill tokens name a field the platform defines
questions.stem: A city planner's memo wants autofill for an email input; which autocomplete value is correct?
questions.explanation: The standard autocomplete token for email is 'email'. Nonstandard values are ignored by autofill.
